title: HSK Reading: 判断对错 & 阅读理解
description: HSK-style reading: decide whether the ★ statement is true, or answer the ★ question about a short text. Everything hinges on the A2 grammar.

points.title: 判断对错: true or false?
points.summary: Read the passage, then decide if the ★ statement matches it.
points.body:
Grammar traps to watch for:
- **不…了** (not anymore) vs **没** (didn't).
- **还没** = not yet; **已经…了** = already.
- **过** = has ever done.
- **比 / 没有 / 一样** comparisons — work out who is taller/older.
- **快…了** = not yet, but soon.
examples: {我|wǒ}{以前|yǐqián}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kāfēi}，{现在|xiànzài}{不|bù}{喝|hē}{了|le}。
I used to like coffee, but I don't drink it anymore.

points.title: 阅读理解: answer the ★ question
points.summary: Read the short passage and pick the answer it supports. Often one detail — a time, a comparison, a reason with 因为 — decides it.
points.body:
- Look for the connector: 因为 / 所以 / 但是.
- Do the arithmetic with times and ages.
- Wrong options often repeat words from the text but change their meaning.
examples: There was a lot of traffic, so I arrived late.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{以前|yǐqián}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐhuan}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kāfēi}，{每天|měitiān}{喝|hē}{三|sān}{杯|bēi}，{可是|kěshì}{现在|xiànzài}{不|bù}{喝|hē}{了|le}。

★ {他|tā}{现在|xiànzài}{不|bù}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kāfēi}。
notes: 不喝了 = he doesn't drink it anymore — so the statement is true.
questions.translation: I used to love coffee and drank three cups a day, but now I don't drink it anymore. ★ He doesn't drink coffee now.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōngguó}{三|sān}{年|nián}{了|le}，{去|qù}{过|guo}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{地方|dìfang}，{可是|kěshì}{还|hái}{没|méi}{去|qù}{过|guo}{上海|Shànghǎi}。

★ {他|tā}{去|qù}{过|guo}{上海|Shànghǎi}。
notes: 还没去过上海 = he hasn't been to Shanghai yet.
questions.translation: I've been in China for three years and have been to many places, but I haven't been to Shanghai yet. ★ He has been to Shanghai.

questions.prompt:
{哥哥|gēge}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{大|dà}{两|liǎng}{岁|suì}，{我|wǒ}{今年|jīnnián}{十八|shíbā}{岁|suì}。

★ {哥哥|gēge}{今年|jīnnián}{二十|èrshí}{岁|suì}。
questions.translation: My older brother is two years older than me; I'm eighteen this year. ★ My brother is twenty this year.

questions.prompt:
{电影|diànyǐng}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{开始|kāishǐ}，{现在|xiànzài}{已经|yǐjīng}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{四十|sìshí}{了|le}，{我们|wǒmen}{快|kuài}{点儿|diǎnr}{走|zǒu}{吧|ba}！

★ {电影|diànyǐng}{还|hái}{没|méi}{开始|kāishǐ}。
notes: It started at 7:30 and it's already 7:40 — so it has started.
questions.translation: The film starts at 7:30 and it's already 7:40 — let's hurry! ★ The film hasn't started yet.

questions.prompt:
{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{跟|gēn}{小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}{一样|yíyàng}{高|gāo}，{小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}{比|bǐ}{小张|Xiǎo Zhāng}{高|gāo}。

★ {小张|Xiǎo Zhāng}{比|bǐ}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{高|gāo}。
notes: Wang = Li, and Li is taller than Zhang — so Wang is taller than Zhang, not the other way round.
questions.translation: Xiao Wang is as tall as Xiao Li, and Xiao Li is taller than Xiao Zhang. ★ Xiao Zhang is taller than Xiao Wang.

questions.prompt:
{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{东西|dōngxi}{又|yòu}{便宜|piányi}{又|yòu}{好|hǎo}，{所以|suǒyǐ}{每天|měitiān}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}。

★ {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{东西|dōngxi}{不|bú}{贵|guì}。
notes: 又便宜又好 — cheap means not expensive, so it's true.
questions.translation: The things in this shop are cheap and good, so it's busy every day. ★ The things in this shop aren't expensive.

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{刚|gāng}{到|dào}{家|jiā}，{还|hái}{没|méi}{吃饭|chīfàn}{呢|ne}，{你|nǐ}{等|děng}{我|wǒ}{一下|yíxià}。

★ {他|tā}{已经|yǐjīng}{吃|chī}{了|le}{饭|fàn}。
notes: 还没吃饭呢 = he hasn't eaten yet.
questions.translation: I've only just got home and haven't eaten yet — wait for me a moment. ★ He has already eaten.

questions.prompt:
{今天|jīntiān}{我|wǒ}{起床|qǐchuáng}{起|qǐ}{得|de}{太|tài}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{路|lù}{上|shang}{车|chē}{又|yòu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{到|dào}{公司|gōngsī}，{比|bǐ}{平时|píngshí}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}{一个|yí ge}{小时|xiǎoshí}。

★ {他|tā}{平时|píngshí}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{公司|gōngsī}？
notes: 比平时晚了一个小时 = an hour, not half an hour.
That would be an hour later, not earlier.
questions.translation: I got up too late today and there was lots of traffic, so I got to the office at 9:30 — an hour later than usual. ★ When does he usually get to the office?

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|ge}{姐姐|jiějie}。{大姐|dàjiě}{是|shì}{医生|yīshēng}，{二姐|èrjiě}{是|shì}{老师|lǎoshī}。{二姐|èrjiě}{没有|méiyǒu}{大姐|dàjiě}{忙|máng}，{可是|kěshì}{比|bǐ}{大姐|dàjiě}{累|lèi}。

★ {关于|guānyú}{二姐|èrjiě}，{可以|kěyǐ}{知道|zhīdào}：
notes: 没有大姐忙 = she's NOT as busy.
The doctor is the eldest sister.
questions.translation: I have two older sisters. The eldest is a doctor, the second a teacher. The second isn't as busy as the eldest, but she's more tired. ★ What do we know about the second sister?

questions.prompt:
{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{了|le}{一|yì}{年|nián}{汉语|Hànyǔ}{了|le}。{我|wǒ}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{懂|dǒng}{简单|jiǎndān}{的|de}{书|shū}，{可是|kěshì}{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}{中国人|Zhōngguórén}{说话|shuōhuà}，{因为|yīnwèi}{他们|tāmen}{说|shuō}{得|de}{太|tài}{快|kuài}{了|le}。

★ {他|tā}{为什么|wèishénme}{听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}？
notes: He has studied for a year.
听不见 = can't hear — it's about speed, not volume.
questions.translation: I've been learning Chinese for a year. I can read simple books, but I can't understand Chinese people talking because they speak too fast. ★ Why can't he understand?

questions.prompt:
{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{每天|měitiān}{早上|zǎoshang}{一边|yìbiān}{吃|chī}{早饭|zǎofàn}{一边|yìbiān}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒujī}，{妈妈|māma}{总是|zǒngshì}{说|shuō}：“{别|bié}{看|kàn}{了|le}！”

★ {妈妈|māma}{希望|xīwàng}{小明|Xiǎo Míng}：
notes: She objects to the phone, not to breakfast.
questions.translation: Every morning Xiao Ming looks at his phone while eating breakfast, and his mum always says: 'Stop looking at it!' ★ What does his mum want?
